verdict.rationale: Customer.io has its own in-product AI agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The evidence only covers server-side and outbound AI access: an official Customer.io MCP server for external AI clients, a CLI with skills, and a Claude plugin. Nothing shows the Customer.io agent connecting to user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools, and server-role evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.
